note: Card Y02: the automated scenario set. Each scenario names the compiled test files of a package ("pkg/path" is packages/pkg/dist/path.test.js) that prove one acceptance clause on the production code. `platforms` says where the scenario must pass; `platformFiles` adds files that only make sense on one platform. `minTests` is a floor: a file that was emptied or stopped registering its tests cannot keep a scenario green. Changing this file changes its digest, and a report made from another version is refused by the gate. `notApplicable` names, per platform, the exact skip reasons (or a prefix ending in *) of tests that do not apply there, such as a Linux-only test on macOS: they are counted apart, never as passes, and any other skip fails the scenario. Linux has none. `minTests` counts the tests the files register; on Linux, where nothing may skip, that is the passing floor.
